params.body:
#48 sized the hero as the screen minus the header (176px) and the category bar (105px). The bar is not always 105px: its height depends on how the labels wrap ("Brandweerwagens"), and locally it is 91px. Where the bar came out lower, the difference showed as a white strip below it.

Hero and category bar now share one column, from `lg` on, that is the screen height minus the header. The hero takes what the bar leaves, whatever the bar's height. The header measures 175.5px; the column uses 175px, so it ends half a pixel past the fold instead of leaving a hairline.

Measured locally, with the bar as it renders and forced to 80px and 130px:

- 1440x900, 1470x956, 1920x1080 and 2560x1440: the bar ends at the bottom of the screen in every case. The only exception is 1440x900 with a 130px bar, where the hero keeps its content height of 610px and the bar runs 15px past the fold.
- 1366x768: unchanged, the hero keeps its 610px.
- Phones and tablets: unchanged.

All hero text still reaches AAA at 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920px. Full suite: 85 tests green.
params.title: Home hero: no white strip below the category bar
